name: AutoBench-V
description: AutoBench-V is an automated evaluation framework for large vision-language models (LVLMs) that generates image samples and orchestrates visual question-answering tasks to benchmark LVLM capabilities flexibly and efficiently.
reputation: A recent automated LVLM evaluation framework that has seen some interest for scalable benchmarking, but is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Framework uses text-to-image models to generate evaluation data and LVLMs to perform VQA; aims to reduce human cost and increase flexibility in LVLM evaluation.
